jobs.prompt: Create a full-body six-frame idle ANIMATED ILLUSTRATION SOURCE SHEET, 3 columns by 2 rows, equal cells with generous transparent gutters. Same complete adult character head to soles in every cell, same held three-quarter pose, face and costume identity. Frames are successive moments of one CALM 4.8-second breathing loop, including visibly shifting loose hair tips and garment hem, anchored feet and attached roots. Frame 1 rest eyes open; frame 2 breath rise eyes half-closed; frame 3 top of breath eyes naturally closed; frame 4 breath fall eyes open; frame 5 settle eyes open with hair following through; frame 6 returns towards original pose. Actual authored eyelid change and hair/cloth motion, not six duplicates. Genuine transparent background. Style combine reference 1 mature detailed refined painterly construction with reference 2 pixel texture/cel shadow groups and semi-bold stepped contours. No swords, armor, wings, combat, enrage, extra props, fantasy cape, flirty pose, HUD, text, labels or watermark. These are friendly noncombat story NPCs for a cyberpunk RPG, not the reference swordsman. Preserve mature practical proportions, readable face and every boot. Character: MARA SOLIS, warm but practical field medic in her thirties, medium warm-brown skin, hazel eyes, short dark cropped/swept hair with a few loose tips, no headwear, no glasses. Sage utility VEST over a cream short-sleeve work shirt, charcoal full-length TROUSERS, brown sturdy boots, modest belt and small plain medical backpack. No exposed midriff or cleavage, no skirt, no logos or medical cross. Hands relaxed, quietly attentive expression, slightly tired kind eyes. Vest fabric and short fringe should visibly follow calm breath while face stays registered. No held implement.
